answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The lotus cap is enforced at intake and horizon publishes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a quartz tag. That is 16 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
